name: scan-upgrade
description: Wallet scans written by the v6.0.8 release, read after an in-place upgrade to this role's jar (ergoplatform/ergo#1668, the scan id type). One node: the release registers scan 11 (the emission contract) and scan 12 (the miner's reward script) and mines until they hold boxes; the node is stopped and started on this role's jar over the same data directory, and /scan/listAll, /scan/unspentBoxes, /scan/spentBoxes and /wallet/transactionsByScanId must answer as the release did at the same height; then 5 more blocks must be tracked and the next scan must get id 13. pass = all of that. Both roles: pass true.
